== Summary ==
[[Jon Snyder]] at the Decipher booth, Comic-Con 2001. Cropped to him from [[:File:Decipher staff Comic-Con 2001.jpg]] (the uncropped original); brightness raised, not resized.

* '''Source:''' [http://www.theonering.net/movie/scrapbook/large/1536 Comic-Con 2001: Decipher], TheOneRing.net scrapbook (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010805025951/http://www.theonering.net:80/movie/scrapbook/large/1536 Internet Archive] (5 August 2001).
* '''Photographer:''' unknown (TheOneRing.net scrapbook, source "Comic-Con 2001").
* '''Date:''' 19 July 2001 (camera date stamp); Comic-Con International, San Diego.
* '''Identification:''' The source caption reads "From L to R: Sean Smallman (Star Trek and small convention promotions), Jon Snyder (VP Fan Club Operations), Kevin Reitzel (Product Champion Coordinator), Kyle Heuer (Promotions Coordinator)". Jon Snyder is named second, so he is the man second from left, white shirt with shoulder bag.

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a small crop of a 640 by 480 convention snapshot published by TheOneRing.net in 2001, used only to identify a Decipher staff member on his article on a non-commercial fan wiki. No free photograph of him from his Decipher years is known, and the crop cannot harm any market for the original.

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-9/9e/Jon_Snyder_Comic-Con_2001.jpg Internet Archive item].
